summary: Hospital leaders hear directly from the president what they must change to receive federal payments.
realLife: Johnson called hospital leaders to the White House and backed the Medicare desegregation condition.
gates: Hospital participation is in doubt before the program opens.
inGame: needs: an executive meeting with hospital representatives tied to a certification condition.

turns.what: An association officer attends and takes the condition back to hospital boards.
turns.pulledBy: The invitation reaches the association before local boards can meet.
turns.writesBack: The local boards receive the officer's report.

turns.what: A hospital leader calls for a second meeting about the compliance deadline.
turns.pulledBy: The board accepts the condition but has yet to approve the revised policy.
turns.writesBack: The follow-up concerns timing and leaves the condition in force.
